mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM do not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months do not correlate with subsequent consumer spending increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals supply chain disruptions or weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month do not correlate with subsequent economic activity weakening.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent consumer spending increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases > 10% in 3 months do not correlate with subsequent economic activity strengthening.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a potential economic slowdown due to tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.
